description: Small code patches. The global glyph advance (byte at RAM 0x800B3F6A, set by 0x8004E750 with 14 or 16) must be 14 for evenly spaced letter-pair English; screens that set 16 are changed to 14 here. See docs/game-internals.md 6a.

bytes.comment: NAME_ENT init: set_glyph_advance(16) -> 14 (delay slot of jal 0x8004E750 at 0x801321B4)
